import java.io.StringReader;
import java.util.Arrays;

public final class LearnerProbe {
    private LearnerProbe() {}
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        try (Main.TokenReader in = new Main.TokenReader(new StringReader("4 6\n3 3 3 3\n"))) {
            Main.InputData input = Main.readInput(in);
            assert input.timeLimit() == 6;
            assert Arrays.equals(input.durations(), new int[] {3, 3, 3, 3});
            try {
                Main.finishesWithin(input.durations(), 2, input.timeLimit());
                throw new AssertionError("Schedule task must remain unfinished.");
            } catch (UnsupportedOperationException expected) {
                assert expected.getMessage().contains("finishesWithin");
            }
            try {
                Main.minimumStageSize(input);
                throw new AssertionError("Search task must remain unfinished.");
            } catch (UnsupportedOperationException expected) {
                assert expected.getMessage().contains("minimumStageSize");
            }
        }
        System.out.println("Supplied helpers and unfinished tasks verified.");
    }
}
